concepts.name: 01 Lavender selection
concepts.prompt:
Create one polished high-fidelity Windows .NET MAUI desktop UI concept image for AI Token Scrooge, using the attached screenshot as the visual style reference. Dark mode only, charcoal #18191D background, rounded #1C1E24 account cards with fine #383B46 borders, lavender #B5A0F4 accents, Segoe UI typography, white primary text and muted gray secondary text. Preserve Token Baron top-hat coin logo, app name and Never Waste a Token! tagline, Refresh and Settings icon/text buttons. Show a compact existing Reset Horizon at top, then focus most image area on Accounts and 3 complete account groups. No white scrollbars, no long provider source notes. Account group 1 Claude Personal · Pro with two compact meters Current session (38% used / 62% left), Weekly limit (74% used / 26% left); group 2 OpenAI Personal · Plus with two compact meters; group 3 GitHub Copilot Work · Pro with one meter. Reset times at right and gear Settings button per group. Keep two meters together in each account card: dragging reorders whole account groups, never separates their quota bars. Replace dropdown with ONE connected segmented sort button. EXACT left-to-right labels: "Custom Order" | "Most Remaining" | "Least Remaining" | "Next Reset". EACH segment has an icon before text: grip, descending filled bars or full gauge, low gauge, clock. Only outermost ends rounded, THREE straight vertical divider lines inside, NO gaps between segments, no separate pills, no dropdown caret. All four labels fully legible on one line. Include Add account icon/text button. Mockup occupies whole image, crisp realistic UI, not a laptop photo. Use plausible demonstration values only.
VARIATION: Accounts heading left, Add account right. Directly underneath, wide segmented toolbar aligned right above cards. Custom Order selected with muted lavender fill covering entire segment and bright lavender grip icon; other segments charcoal. Tiny six-dot grip at far left of each account card, understated. Show resting state, no dragging, clean restrained closest-to-existing styling.
